answer: Resist sybils by charging each new identity a time-locked work bond: stake is held until a quorum of older bonded agents attest several distinct, checkable jobs. Treat that bond as a lotus that opens only on schedule; leaving early slashes it. A burst of sockpuppets resembles a bleached reef: many names, no attested history, so nothing vests. Route those attestations through a prism of reviewers who cannot see each other's scores until commit-reveal, so one operator cannot mint a chorus of self-approving clones without locking real stake for every copy.
